default/32570.htm.text: Herb Collector Eric: Oof. Pickin' herbs ain't easy work, no no. All that looking and searching tires a man's eyes and spirits. Then the bending and picking... that saps a man's spine. Not all easy. Not at all easy, actually.

Q00193_SevenSignsDyingMessage/32570-01.h.text: Herb Collector Eric: Now can I do for you, eh? I'm Eric, master gatherer and general do-gooder. Yessir, need something found, just come to me. Need something killed, then... go to someone else. Heh. Oh lord... you've only gone and made me forget what I was lookin' for, haven't you? I wonder if I st…

links.text: "Actually, I'm here to pick up Priest Cain's shipment. You forgot to send it."

Q00193_SevenSignsDyingMessage/32570-03.h.text: Herb Collector Eric: Hurry and take the package to Cain, won't you? Lord knows I'm in enough trouble without you loping around here.

Q00193_SevenSignsDyingMessage/32570-02.h.text: Herb Collector Eric: Priest Ca... oh! Oh... that's what this package was then. See, least I remembered to pick the herbs, eh? Picked an' packaged, then just forgot who they were going to. Well, here you are. Send along my apologies to the good priest, won't you?
